TC3.4_MidiInputTiming.js: Requires the macOS virtual CoreMIDI fixture and run_native_midi_timing_test.py to send timestamped MIDI.
TC3.8_MidiInputOwnership.js: Requires the virtual CoreMIDI fixture and run_native_midi_ownership_test.py to disconnect the owned input during the test.
TC3.10_NativeInstrumentPersistence.js: Requires a separately installed native instrument (Surge XT by default); built-in instrument persistence is covered by automated unit and UI tests.
TC3.12_AutomatedInsertDelay.js: Requires the test-only LV2 fixed-block effect bundle from the au3audio test build, which is not part of the distributable app.
TC3.16_MissingInsert.js: Requires run_native_missing_effect_test.py to remove and restore its owned LV2 fixture across three app processes.
TC3.17_NativeAudioCapture.js: Requires a physical recording device selected through the test arguments; standard hosted CI uses virtual playback audio.
TC3.19_MidiInstrumentControls.js: Requires installed Arturia Analog Lab V and the owned CoreMIDI control-message driver.
